source_title: Taurus Horoscope Today, October 29, 2026: Will Act with Wisdom, Will Connect with New Subjects - India Today
source_excerpt:
Taurus Zodiac Sign Horoscope Prediction Today: Will act with discretion. Will connect with new subjects. Will be clear in discussions and conversations. Health will improve. Will increase social interactions. Will show speed in tasks.
The atmosphere at home will be joyful. Opportunities to meet relatives will increase. You will succeed in creative work. Important outcomes will be favourable. Modern efforts will be strengthened. The profit percentage will remain high. Plans for auspicious activities will take shape. You will respect everyone. You will act with sensitivity. The course of time indicates auspiciousness. You will maintain the expected performance in career and business. Help from everyone will be received. Various matters will turn favourable. You will improve communication and contact with colleagues.
Job and Business - There will be a positive surge in the workplace. You will succeed in increasing desired achievements. Efforts will receive support. There will be improvement in artistic skills. You will maintain focus on your goals.
Wealth and Property - You will secure financial interests. Profits will remain good. You will promote new activities. You will take the lead in leadership roles. There will be an inclination towards commercial matters. Industry and business will remain excellent.
Love and Friendship - The emotional side will be nurtured. Happiness and cooperation will continue. You will advance efforts of love and affection. Relationships will be strong. Desired information will be received. You will impress loved ones. Opportunities for meetings will increase. There will be a flow of auspiciousness. You will be able to express your mind.
Health and Morale - You will act with discretion. You will connect with new subjects. You will be clear in discussions and communication. Health will improve. Social interaction will increase. You will show speed in tasks.
Today’s remedy: Married women should observe the Karva Chauth fast for the health and protection of their husband and family. Offer water to the moon. Worship and praise Goddess Lakshmi.
